questions.question: Verify the school and university appointment chronology in Königsberg and Bonn, and the current administrative description of Aleksoty.

localizations.source: Verify the school and university appointment chronology in Königsberg and Bonn, and the current administrative description of Aleksoty.
localizations.ru: Уточнить хронологию гимназии и университетских назначений в Кёнигсберге и Бонне, а также современное административное описание Алексот.

questions.resolution: The chronology now follows the ETH Zürich and Deutsche Biographie accounts; Aleksoty is described as part of the city of Kaunas, in line with the Kaunas municipality’s current administrative listing.

questions.question: Confirm the use of “geometrodynamics” for Minkowski’s model and the nature of the stated connection with Lobachevsky geometry.

localizations.source: Confirm the use of “geometrodynamics” for Minkowski’s model and the nature of the stated connection with Lobachevsky geometry.
localizations.ru: Согласовать употребление «геометродинамики» для модели Минковского и характер заявленной связи с геометрией Лобачевского.

questions.resolution: The term “geometrodynamics” and the unsupported direct link to Lobachevsky geometry were removed. Both editions now describe Minkowski’s documented contribution as a four-dimensional geometric formulation of special relativity.
